sloka: आरोपयित्वा मौर्वीम् च पूरयामास वीर्यवान् ।तत् बभंज धनुर् मध्ये नरश्रेष्ठो महायशाः ॥१-६७-१७॥
transliteration: āropayitvā maurvīm ca pūrayāmāsa vīryavān ।tat babhaṁja dhanur madhye naraśreṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-67-17॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, righteous and famous lifted the bow. Stringing it with a twang he drew it and broke it into two in the middle.
